title: FinSight AI
description: A financial intelligence concept designed to help African SMEs understand financial data and support better decision-making.

title: Data Analysis
description: An exploratory data analysis project examining COVID-19 trends across Kenya, India, the United States, and China. The project involved data cleaning, transformation, statistical analysis, and visualization to identify patterns in COVID-19 cases, death rates, and vaccination trends. Interactive and geographic visualizations were also developed to communicate key findings and support data-driven interpretation.
technologies: Python · Pandas · NumPy · Matplotlib · Seaborn · Plotly · Jupyter Notebook

title: Stress Detection with AI
description: An AI-driven stress detection system built on wearable biosensor data (EDA and skin temperature), exploring how physiological signals can flag stress states in real time. Combines unsupervised clustering with supervised classification to distinguish stress from non-stress states, supporting UN SDG 3 (Good Health and Well-being) through early, non-invasive mental health
technologies: Python · Jupyter Notebook · pandas · NumPy · scikit-learn (Random Forest

title: Resilience Capital
description:
Climate-Adaptive Micro-Lending for Off-Grid Solar Vendors

Resilience Capital is a climate-adaptive micro-lending platform designed to help off-grid solar vendors access financing in drought-prone regions. The platform combines climate data, alternative credit signals, parametric insurance, and dynamic loan pricing to turn climate risk into a tool for building more resilient businesses.

title: Building Age Classification Using Satellite Data
description: A machine learning project using satellite data to classify building age, combining feature engineering, XGBoost, and cross-city transfer learning.  3rd Place at the SEKU Data Science Regional Hackathon.
fullDescription: A machine learning project that classifies building age using multi-year satellite data. The project combines data preprocessing, feature engineering, XGBoost, and cross-city transfer learning to train on Madrid data and adapt the model to Amsterdam using limited labeled data. The project earned 3rd place at the SEKU Data Science Regional Hackathon
